title: Gopuff Delivery Zone Check
description: Result of a Powered by Gopuff delivery-zone eligibility check for a consumer address or coarse IP location.

in_zone.description: True when the supplied location falls inside a Gopuff micro-fulfillment center delivery zone.

mfc_id.description: Identifier of the Gopuff micro-fulfillment center that would service the order.

delivery_eta_minutes_min.description: Lower bound of the expected delivery window in minutes.

delivery_eta_minutes_max.description: Upper bound of the expected delivery window in minutes.
